title: Resolve confirmed publication witnesses once per binding during task-sync capture
outcome: Avoid decoding the same confirmed outgoing operation once per native task during a single export or import capture.
acceptance: One capture resolves each binding's selected confirmed operation and predecessor member data once, while preserving canonical provenance and per-task disclosure rules.
A behavioral cost regression covers several worked-on tasks in one confirmed delta publication and proves operation decoding does not grow once per task.
No durable shape or projection change is introduced solely for the transient cache.
